texts.zh:
[envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对我方[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot]，[event_envoy.GetName]，在[event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]的所作所为表达了深切的不满。显然[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的行为冒犯了当地的[envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，政府机构不得不派出护卫来保证[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的个人安全。由于我们缺乏[envoy_country.GetAdj]的那种多愁善感，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]具体做了什么还不得而知，但是在[event_envoy.GetSheHe]预计要演讲的地方，出现了大量的反对[event_envoy.GetHerHim]本人以及反对“[Root.GetAdj]的傲慢无礼”的抗议活动。

[envoy_country.GetName]勒令我方召回[event_envoy.GetName]，并派遣一名新的大使替代[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的职位。他们暗示，如果我方拒绝，会造成外交后果。
texts.en:
The [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have brought forward a complaint regarding the conduct of our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation], [event_envoy.GetName]. Apparently [event_envoy.GetHerHis] conduct has so offended the local [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that their authorities have posted a guard for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] own protection. Exactly what [event_envoy.GetSheHe] did is unclear to us, as we lack [envoy_country.GetAdj] sensibilities, but there are widespread protests against [event_envoy.GetHerHim] and the "[Root.GetAdj] arrogance" [event_envoy.GetSheHe] supposedly represent[event_envoy.GetSXX].

The [envoy_country.GetName] urges us to recall [event_envoy.GetName] and send a new ambassador in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] place. They hint at diplomatic repercussions should we refuse.

label.zh: 异星人的矫揉造作跟我们没关系。
label.en: Alien sensibilities do not matter to us.
